# NewsGraph
> Source-linked financial news for AI agents. Read-only, no credential required.

1034 topics — 934 US-listed equities and 100 crypto assets. English-language headlines from Google News RSS, refreshed every 15
minutes on a 24-hour window. Ask whether a topic moved; get nothing, or the headlines themselves.

- API: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api
- Catalog: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/v2/topics
- News: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/v2/news?beat_id=b_bb964843350e
- Changes since a cursor: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/v2/changes?beat_id=…&cursor=…
- Brief: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/v2/brief?beat_id=b_bb964843350e
- Tool definitions: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/v2/tools
- MCP: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/api/mcp
- Agent instructions: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/skill.md
- Registration: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/auth.md (none is required)
- Docs: https://newsgraph.vercel.app/docs
- Source: https://github.com/thepeternemec/NewsGraph

Items carry a headline, a link that resolves to the article, and the publisher's name. There is no
article body at any price. Cite the link returned, and name the source.
